title: Track demos of glyphcore/dnb-electro
doc: The DnB tutorial and the electro and house / techno / trance examples (docs/tracks/dnb-electro-tutorial). The Syntax entries carry the standalone programs (generated by tools/packs/dnb_electro.mjs from the pack versions).

section.title: Track demos: DnB, electro, house / techno / trance
section.explain: Whole tracks on pack glyphcore/dnb-electro and the EDM foundations of glyphcore/edm, one lesson per section (docs/tracks/dnb-electro-tutorial/README.md). The entries are the standalone programs (atoms and racks inlined); the pack versions (track.strudel.js, electro.strudel.js, house.strudel.js) only import them. Sidechain = glyphcore/edm sidechain on the kick and ducked on the targets; risers, impacts, crashes and downlifters on gated binds; filter moves (thinBuild, filterBuild, static lpf / hpf chains) on section gates; breaks chopped by a gated bite slot; buses with ret() and tagged().send().
